name: TPS Eastern Africa (Serena) Ltd
source: TPS Eastern Africa PLC audited financial results for the year ended 31 December 2025, consolidated statement of profit or loss (announcement, pages 1 to 2); absolute KES | CRON 20260930_141849: Operating Expenses FY2024 filled at 3,641,899,000 from the collector's own kenyanstocks.com source row group total Operating Expenses. FY2025 has no such row and is left blank rather than inferred. | CRON 20261005_1345: FY2025 Operating Expenses and Operating Profit (EBIT) filled from the audited results announcement for the year ended 31 December 2025, consolidated statement of profit or loss, KShs thousands: Revenue from contracts with customers 10,116,746; Inventory expensed (1,412,282); Employee benefits expense (2,950,149); Other operating expenses (3,736,017); Impairment loss on financial assets (63,865); Depreciation on right of use assets (85,920); Depreciation on property and equipment (627,836); Other income 320,099; Finance income 42,975; Finance costs (393,819); Profit before income tax 1,212,119; Income tax (424,965); Profit for the year 787,154. Operating Expenses is the sum of every printed operating cost line; Operating Profit (EBIT) is the result after those lines, excluding Other income which the panel has no row for. Source: https://document-tc.galaxy.tf/wdpdf-zg87bfxkcs2fugvz43jy2p0b/file.pdf | CRON 2026-10-12 (r15c): H1 2026 column filled from TPS Eastern Africa PLC unaudited financial results for the six months period ended 30 June 2026, condensed consolidated statement of profit or loss, KShs thousands scaled to absolute KES. Printed Group column: revenue from contracts with customers 3,998,103; other income 220,855; operating expenses (3,701,814); profit before depreciation, finance costs, results of associate companies and income tax 517,144; depreciation and amortisation (387,462); net finance cost (185,192); share of loss of associates (19,643); loss before income tax (75,153); income tax credit 8,775; loss for the period (66,378) of which equity holders (33,868) and non-controlling interest (32,510); basic and diluted earnings per share (0.12) KShs. Printed column ties: 517,144 less 387,462 less 185,192 less 19,643 equals (75,153); (75,153) plus the 8,775 tax credit equals (66,378). Operating Profit (EBIT) carries the printed profit before depreciation and finance costs less depreciation and amortisation less the share of loss of associates, so that the rendered identity Operating Profit less Net Finance Costs equals Profit Before Tax holds exactly; the schema carries no associates row. Income Tax is stored negative because the period carries a tax credit. Net Finance Costs is stored positive as a cost; note the stored FY2025 and FY2024 columns of this file carry that row with the opposite sign, which is a pre-existing inconsistency in those columns and is left as it stands. The announcement prints no cost of sales or gross profit line, so those two cells stay empty. Source: https://document-tc.galaxy.tf/wdpdf-5a8s7m2w3fu3hlch07ppig4we/file.pdf
note: Revenue is revenue from contracts with customers as printed. Cost of Sales is inventory expensed as printed. Each derived row states its formula; Profit Before Tax, Income Tax, Net Profit and EPS are as printed.
reconciliation_note: Revenue minus Cost of Sales equals Gross Profit, and Profit Before Tax minus Income Tax equals Net Profit, on both periods

rows.label: Cost of Sales

rows.label: Operating Expenses
rows.derived_from: Employee benefits plus other operating expenses plus impairment loss plus depreciation, as printed
rows.derivedCellFormula: Employee benefits 2,950,149 plus Other operating expenses 3,736,017 plus Impairment loss on financial assets 63,865 plus depreciation on right of use assets 85,920 plus depreciation on property and equipment 627,836 (KShs thousands)

rows.label: Operating Profit (EBIT)
rows.derived_from: Profit before depreciation, finance income and costs, results of associates and income tax, less depreciation
rows.derivedFormula: Operating Profit (EBIT) = Gross Profit - Operating Expenses
rows.derivedCellFormula: Gross Profit less Operating Expenses (8,704,464 - 7,463,787), excluding Other income of 320,099 which has no row in the panel schema

rows.label: Net Finance Costs
rows.derived_from: Finance costs less finance income, as printed

rows.label: Income Tax
rows.sign_normalized: negated to the dataset convention: stored negative, which broke the printed identity Profit Before Tax - Income Tax = Net Profit, and the column ties with it positive
